description: Dashboard: update compliance.service.ts to POST /api/v1/runs, update compliance.types.ts for new response shape, blank hardcoded default inputs in audit/page.tsx. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except for the API URL change in compliance.service.ts which requires the new /runs endpoint to exist. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before any code changes per dashboard/AGENTS.md.
steps: Read dashboard/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ to check for any Next.js 16 breaking changes relevant to the files being changed (page components, hooks, client components). Confirm 'use client' directive placement and any new import requirements for Next.js 16.

In dashboard/app/lib/services/compliance.service.ts: change runE2E() POST URL from '/api/v1/compliance/run-e2e' to '/api/v1/runs'. Change listRuns() GET URL from '/api/v1/compliance/runs' to '/api/v1/runs'. Change getRun() GET URL from '/api/v1/compliance/runs/${id}' to '/api/v1/runs/${id}'. Remove getRunSteps() method (the new /runs/{id} endpoint does not return a steps array from the DB — steps are in Temporal; if steps are needed in the future, that is a separate call). Keep the method signature types consistent with updated types.

In dashboard/app/lib/types/compliance.types.ts: update E2ERunResult interface — make 'steps' optional: 'steps?: E2EStep[]'. Add fields: 'temporal_run_id?: string', 'hitl_required?: boolean'. Update RunE2EParams to add 'org_id?: string'. The existing fields (run_id, status, temporal_workflow_id, etc.) remain unchanged.

In dashboard/app/audit/page.tsx: change 'useState("RECYC-DELHI-01")' to 'useState("")'. Change 'useState("PLANT-OKHLA-2")' to 'useState("")'. Add 'placeholder' props to the RecyclerId TextField ('e.g. RECYC-DL-001') and PlantId TextField ('e.g. PLANT-MH-01'). No other logic changes — the audit page does not call the compliance service, it calls auditSvc.triggerAudit() which POSTs to /api/v1/audit/trigger (unchanged endpoint).

In dashboard/app/dispatch/page.tsx: no changes required — this page calls settlementSvc.listForm1s() and settlementSvc.listPOs() which map to /api/v1/settlement/form1 and /api/v1/settlement/pos (unchanged endpoints). The dispatchForm1() call maps to POST /api/v1/settlement/form1/dispatch (currently returns 501 — this is not changed in Phase 2).
acceptance_criteria: cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no type errors
compliance.service.ts contains '/api/v1/runs' and does not contain '/api/v1/compliance/run-e2e'
audit/page.tsx contains 'useState("")' for recyclerId and plantId initial values, not 'useState("RECYC-DELHI-01")' or 'useState("PLANT-OKHLA-2")'
No occurrence of 'RECYC-DELHI-01' or 'PLANT-OKHLA-2' in dashboard/app/audit/page.tsx
